sql: SELECT TOP 10 ps.PaymentCode AS paymentCode, ps.PaymentName AS paymentName, COALESCE(sp.dn, ps.PaymentDisplayName) AS displayName FROM dbo.ZnodePaymentSetting ps INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePaymentType pt ON pt.PaymentTypeId = ps.PaymentTypeId OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 pps.PaymentSettingId AS sid, pps.PaymentDisplayName AS dn FROM dbo.ZnodePortalPaymentSetting pps INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = pps.PortalId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState pub ON pub.PublishStateId = pps.PublishStateId WHERE pps.PaymentSettingId = ps.PaymentSettingId AND po.StoreCode = @store AND pps.IsUsedForWebStorePayment = @isActive AND pub.PublishStateCode = @publishState) sp WHERE pt.Name = @gatewayType AND pt.Code = @paymentTypeCode AND pt.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.IsActive = @isActive AND (sp.sid IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT pp.ProfilePaymentSettingId FROM dbo.ZnodeProfilePaymentSetting pp INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalProfile ppr ON ppr.ProfileId = pp.ProfileId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po2 ON po2.PortalId = ppr.PortalId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState pub2 ON pub2.PublishStateId = pp.PublishStateId WHERE pp.PaymentSettingId = ps.PaymentSettingId AND po2.StoreCode = @store AND (pp.PublishStateId IS NULL OR pub2.PublishStateCode = @publishState))) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR ps.PaymentCode = @preferred) ORDER BY ps.PaymentSettingId
